messages.content: Please book my trip to Berlin next month.
What dates will you travel, and what is the business purpose?
May 12 to May 15 for the customer workshop.
Check approval and fare requirements.
Economy airfare is allowed; manager approval is required above $2,000.
Book economy itinerary for May 12-15.
Booking BER-481 confirmed at $1,240.
Your economy itinerary is booked for May 12-15. Confirmation: BER-481.
Also, how many vacation days do I have left?
Retrieve current vacation balance for E001.
E001 has 8.5 vacation days remaining.

I cannot sign in after changing phones.
Do you still have access to your corporate email, and what error do you see?
I can access email. The sign-in page says the authenticator registration is unavailable.
Verify account and revoke the old authenticator registration.
Identity verified; old registration revoked; temporary registration pass issued.
Use the temporary registration pass sent to your corporate email to register the new phone. The old registration has been removed.
My hotel receipt is missing. Can I still submit the expense?
What was the amount, and have you requested a replacement receipt from the hotel?
It was $180. The hotel confirmed they cannot reproduce it.
Check missing-receipt exception requirements.
Expenses below $250 may use a missing-receipt declaration after attempting to obtain a replacement.
Submit a missing-receipt declaration with the $180 expense and attach the hotel's confirmation that a replacement is unavailable.
